task: How is the company doing this week?
answer:
Operations and support saw higher ticket volumes and late deliveries this week, with Hub W2 recording an on-time rate of 77%.

* Support handled 54 tickets this week, an increase of 86% compared to last week, with 59 open tickets and 10 overdue commitments.
* Operations delivered 196 parcels with an 85% on-time rate, while Hub W2 recorded an on-time rate of 77% and 14 parcels late now.
* "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" assumed Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2; this week it is 77%.
* "Promise 2-day delivery to west customers" assumed west deliveries via W2 are 85% on time; this week it is 77%.
